usage.source: Codex CLI final turn.completed usage event

harness.name: Codex CLI
harness.command: codex --search -m gpt-5.6-sol -c 'model_reasoning_effort="medium"' --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox -C /tmp/benchmark-real-ai-gpt-5-6-sol-medium-Y6Tm5j exec --skip-git-repo-check --json -o /tmp/benchmark-real-ai-capture-gpt-5-6-sol-medium-N2xIcd/final-response.txt 'I want to forecast the sp500, show me how to do it in an interactive dashboard in html. Do not stop until you have a working and validated dashboard.'

dataSource.notes: The HTML generates a deterministic 320-row S&P 500-like demonstration series in makeSample() and visibly labels it `Synthetic demo`; users may upload real Date/Close CSV history. No external market data is bundled or fetched.

commands.name: final-repository-validation

After rebasing over the concurrent gpt-5.6-luna medium addition, the same commands passed for 12 runs with 4 unit tests passed and 5 browser tests passed plus 1 skipped.
